versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The implementation of a Cross Clus- ter Communication of an Applicative Software Cluster shall only write into the memory of other Software Clusters , if that write does not cross a Par- tition border. To determine this, the Applicative Software Cluster needs to determine if the CpSoftwareClusterResource is assigned to the same partition.
